notes.title: THE GAUNTLET: Hermit and Pig battle testing opportunity Aug 22-Sep 5
notes.notes:
[p]Hiya![/p][p]
We've been focusing intensely on battles. So much so that we're ready for you to playtest (if you want!) what we're calling THE GUANTLET. This is primarily a testing environment for us, but for you it’s a roguelike-ish, arcade-y, self-contained “game” that focuses on battles.

THE GAUNTLET will run August 22-September 5. To participate you'll just need to use this form to [b][url="https://campaign-statistics.com/link_click/dG3RBK-kZllwKX-4syZ5P/3768e673d2e6d07ce8716cd68d73a195"]sign up[/url][/b], and then we'll email you a game link on the 22nd. 

You can play through THE GAUNTLET as many times as you’d like between August 22 - September 5. All participants will receive a credit in the game, a digital playtester badge (THE GAUNTLET edition), and have the chance to win PRIZES! Prizes include:[/p][list][*][p]$50 Steam gift card to the overall highest score*[/p][/*][*][p]$25 Steam gift card to 2nd and 3rd overall highest scores*[/p][/*][*][p]Hermit and Pig-style sprite of your choosing for achieving other in-game challenges we’ll reveal on Friday[/p][/*][/list][p](*Steam gift cards will be purchased in USD and automatically convert to your local currency upon redemption if you live in another country).

So what will actually happen in THE GAUNTLET? You’ll progress through randomized rooms, fighting three battles in each one, and then visit a hub where you can get an upgrade and some other goodies. You'll progress like this through different rooms until you reach the very end (and hopefully want to run it again and again). Here's a quick look at one of these hubs (which also gives you a sneak peak at how we're using truffles as currency in the game!): [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/3470fec979e7be61ac170a62315d7f4094d3e41d.gif"][/img]
You’ll get to experience about 90-95% of everything that Hermit and Pig has to offer battle-wise, including a wide range of enemies, items and trinkets, upgrades, and our brand new special mini-games.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/ba1ef67375735c197156023f5907cdfd5f50c1d5.gif"][/img][/p][p]Hope to see you in THE GAUNTLET![/p][p]Nathan and Mason[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Out of the woods!
notes.notes:
Greetings! 

Well, we always knew this day would come. Hermit and Pig are actually gonna have to leave their woodland comfort zone if they want to find the Jumbo Fungo and help the townspeople. EXCITING! And we're finally ready to give you a sneak peak of what lies beyond the forest boundary. THRILLING! 

Mason has been grinding for a while now - first mapping out the rest of the game's areas, and then creating art for all these new places - and we wanted to show you a couple of them here. We don’t want to spoil any plot points, so we’ll let the gifs do the heavy lifting this update. But you can be sure they're filled to the brim with new enemies and awkward conversations to survive. 


This first scene is along the docks in the wetlands area. No trees to be found. FINALLY! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/9f4b10722c26b58c2ae0105ee32dcf23bcfc74f6.gif[/img]

And here's a shot from the bustling town area - notice Pig is sans Hermit, what could that mean??? INTRIGUING!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/5a193ca6dd981e814ee230df78262d3d7aa47536.gif[/img]

Finally, a look at what's brewing inside the witch's home. Didn't know there'd be a witch, did you? SPOOKY!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/1e08a1d87e4ff5ce8f791ebddf717db45fe4063d.gif[/img]

Thanks for reading, helping us out, and caring about this game. We appreciate you.

SERIOUSLY,
Nathan and Mason

notes.title: Leveling and Customization
notes.notes:
We’re implementing our ACTUAL leveling system in the game, which will include a new type of item: trinkets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/d05f77c9f9e7c4245b4be0fe1542b85d2c85e117.png[/img]

These are mystical, mysterious, lucky objects that our heroes can equip to modify their abilities. As you level up you’ll be able to equip stronger trinkets. Ya know, like Paper Mario or Hollow Knight. Here are a couple of trinkets you’ll get to use:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/5e5f2bcb932545c10c9f5c97953cd98707fae991.gif[/img]

We’re excited to see your H&P trinket builds! What trinket/effect would you like to see in the game?

P.S. These bad boys will be featured in the new demo update that we’re announcing soon. Keep your eyes peeled.

  P.P.S. “Keep your eyes peeled” is gross. Sorry we said that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/f25d125eebb0fe5d989ae56237f2543ae280779f.png[/img]

notes.title: This new Steam game is Stardew Valley reimagined as a turn-based RPG
notes.notes:
Stardew Valley is an absolute delight, but have you ever wished that you could take on the wildlife (and perhaps even some of its inhabitants) in turn-based RPG combat? With the likes of Honkai Star Rail, Baldur's Gate 3, and Sea of Stars really tickling our tactical neurons in 2023, it's only fair that the format turns its eye to the world of peaceful rural exploration. Enter Hermit and Pig, a delightful indie game promising just that, which has already caught my eye with its charming style.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Untitled
notes.notes:
Howdy!

With this update, we thought it might be cool to take a look at another region of Hermit and Pig’s forest.We wanted to make the area feel overgrown and forgotten, so we stuck to deep greens and textured it with moss, algae, and a lot of vines to walk through.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/8725c1d4b423f6194d6585b3e23894f253b2e683.gif[/img]

This section of the map gives a peek into some of the magical realism that will pop up occasionally throughout the game via some unexplainable creatures (and people). Also a grumpy cat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/91e9ab70d9c9ba71943854454c8de18e086c6c1d.gif[/img]

The Hermit and Pig closed beta demo is happening now! It has been a lot of fun seeing people play for the first time, and we appreciate the extra help finding bugs! Players are also competing for some sweet prizes. If you missed the beta demo this time around, no worries - we'll have plenty of opportunities in the future. Make sure you're signed up to our newsletter so you can stay up to date!

That’s it for now! Hope those of you north of the equator are enjoying the fall weather.

notes.title: The most exciting keyboard news you've heard all week
notes.notes:
Howdy!

The past month has been a busy one as we’ve continued to push to get this demo done. One of the biggest updates was to give the player the option to a) use a controller on computers and b) to customize their controls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/899bc0f45b36527dd00a648b8e6a069945ae9742.gif[/img]

We’re hoping this will give players a more accessible and pleasant experience. And while the technical details of the process are pretty boring, the implications are important. Our battle system is based on directional key combos that roughly correspond to the physical attack (i.e., the Stomp attack suggests a rise and fall motion, while the Punch mimics a real life punch combo, jab-jab-cross).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/5f0a4eb17430ff43c49a69b7f7ac70203ca80aac.gif[/img]

By default, keyboards use WASD for movement so we set those keys as the default for combos as well. HOWEVER. People want to do things the way they want to do them. And we appreciate that. So, if players are so inclined, they can get wild and assign Up to the B key, Down to the 5 key, Left to the /, and Right to the Q key. Just for fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/9cf5ccc3d8863c35fb3454b84399754bc605e5bd.gif[/img]

If you end up playing like this you'll have to report back. Until then, we’ll keep pushing this demo forward and get something for you to play as soon as we can! Make sure you sign up for our newsletter so that you can get access to our closed beta this year: https://www.heavylunch.studio/


Next month we're thinking about covering some mushrooms or NPCs - what do you want to hear about?

notes.title: How does one fend off a crazed squirrel?
notes.notes:
Hey folks,

We’re working on getting our demo in shape for the beta release. Lately we’ve been focused on the battle system, so here are some new enemies:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/9865f6bb01a277ff595f6b899beb77075d7fdb7a.gif[/img]

A big part of our game is puzzling out which attack would be effective on each attacker. So we’re trying to pack TONS of enemies in to keep you on your toes.

How does one fend off a crazed squirrel? Kick? Cane? Slingshot? My uncle got attacked by a squirrel at a birthday party. All he had to defend himself with was a cake plate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/04f8e1d4dd6385ca061c052e97a205c64c785741.gif[/img]

On the overworld, enemies are represented by these sprites:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44231004/739eead933244afdbb003d16e3a722b285772146.gif[/img]

This gives you a slim chance to avoid a fight, but unlike my uncle, you’ve gotta react quickly. 

Well, back to work. We'll be sharing some big news about the beta SOON. In the meantime, sign up for our mailing list to be included in the beta https://heavylunch.studio/. 

This is one of the most exciting projects either of us have worked on, and it means a lot to have you along for the ride. Stay cool.

Mason and Nathan
Heavy Lunch Studio

P.S. - Do you have any ideas for new enemy types? ﻿Let us know.
